title: Black Friday 2026 UK live deals: the best offers right now
seoTitle: Black Friday 2026 UK: Best Live Deals (Updated Today)
description: The best genuine UK Black Friday 2026 deals live right now, checked three times a day. Tech, home, beauty and toys, with prices compared.
intro:
**Last checked: Thursday 26 November, 6pm.** The three standouts right now: the **AirPods Pro 3 at £155.98** at Amazon (still a record low), the **LG C6 65-inch OLED at £1,529.10** at Amazon (down another £120 this afternoon) and the **Fire TV Stick 4K Max at £46.99** at Amazon (more than half off).

Black Friday is tomorrow, Friday 27 November, and Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until 30 November. We check this page three times a day and remove anything that has sold out or gone back up. New this evening: the Fire TV Stick 4K Max at £46.99, a Blink Outdoor 4 + Mini 2K+ pair at £24.99, the Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 at £109.99 and the Ring Battery Doorbell with Indoor Camera at £39.99, all at Amazon. Still live and re-checked this afternoon: the Kindle at £119.99, the Switch 2 Sports Resort bundle at £399, the Lego Game Boy at £35.99, the Suri Pro toothbrush at £83.98 and the Ninja Crispi at £99. We took off the Philips OneBlade 360 (back up to £39.99), the Sonos Ace and the Dyson V15 at Currys to make room. **PS5 buyers:** consoles are still short since GTA VI launched; see our [PS5 guide](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/). Prices were reported on 25–26 November, so check the retailer's page before you buy. Many Amazon prices need Prime: a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the whole sale.

body:
## Tech

Apple: the AirPods Pro 3 are still a record-low £155.98 at Amazon, a single AirTag is £20.50 there, and the Apple Watch Ultra 3 is £495 at Argos. Amazon's own devices: the new Kindle is a record-low £119.99, the Ring Battery Doorbell with an Indoor Camera is £39.99, a Blink Outdoor 4 + Mini 2K+ pair £24.99 and the Fire TV Stick 4K Max £46.99. For TVs, the Hisense 65-inch Canvas is £999, the TCL 55-inch C7L mini-LED is a record-low £749 and the LG C6 65-inch OLED is down to £1,529.10.

For audio, the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 are £126, the Bose QuietComfort Earbuds £99, the Bose Smart Soundbar £329 and the Sonos Beam (Gen 2) £339. The Garmin fēnix 8 (47mm) is £479.99. Gamers: the Asus ROG Xbox Ally is £379.99, and the Switch 2 with Switch Sports Resort is £399, but PS5 consoles are hard to find at the normal price.

More: [Kindle](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ring doorbells](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/), [AirPods](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/), [TVs](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/), [soundbars](/guides/soundbar-deals-uk/), [PS5](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Amazon Black Friday 2026](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## Home & kitchen

The Roborock Qrevo S Pro robot vacuum and mop is £299.99 at Amazon, £250 off. For cordless vacuums, the Dyson V8 Cyclone is its lowest yet at £198.37 at Amazon. In the kitchen, the Philips Baristina with milk frother is £299.99 and the Ninja Crispi glass air fryer is £99, both at Amazon.

More: [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [coffee machines](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Beauty

For teeth, the Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 is £109.99 and the Suri Pro sonic toothbrush £83.98, both at Amazon. The Philips OneBlade 360 has gone back up to £39.99, so we've taken it off. For hair, see our [Dyson Airwrap price guide](/guides/dyson-airwrap-deals-uk/) for today's Airwrap prices. For fragrance gifts, [compare Amazon's perfume gift set prices](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=perfume+gift+set) before you buy.

More: [perfume gift sets](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/), [ghd](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Oral-B](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Toys & gifts

Advent calendars need to arrive by 1 December, so buy those now. The Lego Icons Road Bike is a lowest-ever £86.99 and the Lego Game Boy £35.99, both at Amazon. For readers, an [Audible membership](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) is £0.99 a month for three months until 17 December and can be given as a gift. For toys, Hamleys is running its own Black Friday event, and our guide shows what's worth buying there.

More: [Hamleys Black Friday 2026](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/), [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Lego advent calendars](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/), [Nintendo Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [PS5](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## How we pick these deals

Every price comes from the retailer or a trusted deals source dated today or yesterday. We compare it with price history and last year's Black Friday prices, and we leave out deals where the 'was' price is inflated. When Amazon matches the cheapest shop, we link Amazon. Many Amazon prices need Prime during Black Friday Week; our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time a trial.

### When is Black Friday 2026 in the UK?

Friday 27 November, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. Our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's dates.

### Should I buy now or wait for Black Friday?

If a deal here is marked 'Lowest price', it's already at or below last year's Black Friday price, so buy it. Items marked 'Good price' could still fall a little in the final week.

### How often is this page updated?

Three times a day, every day until Cyber Monday. Deals that end or go up in price are removed.

See [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) for brand-by-brand prices.
